integrity: The noninteger asymptotic is reconstructed from simple-root perturbation, explicit rescaling of the split multiple critical point, a finite max-min distance expansion, and an exact circular-grid argument. Numerical root computations are independent consistency checks and are not used to establish the theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is local along fixed complex polynomial perturbations of a regular binomial, only for integer degrees at least four and directions with nonzero linear coefficient. It does not resolve global equality rigidity at exponent two or cover degenerate transverse directions.
title: Phase-sensitive Puiseux stability of the Borcea variance extremizer
